observations: The page number «48» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01: «wird von Batt.» continues «die Differenz zwischen beiden, der mittlern und der wahren Länge, d. h. der Bogen RQ,» at the end of p. 47 (JP2 0079, L39).

The formulas of L06, L13, L15, L22 and L28 are displayed, each in a line of its own, centred; their fractions are built up, written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}, and the square roots are printed with the radical sign and a bar over the radicand, written {rt:…}. In L13 the bar covers «ρ² − (e sin m / R)²» and «+ e cos m / R» stands after it; in L15 it covers «1 − (e₁ sin m)²»; L14 and L27 have a fraction and the roots within the line. L13 and L15 end with the note numbers, «1)» with a comma after it and «2)» with a full stop. The letters of the figures, e, m, ρ, r, ψ and R are italic, «sin», «cos», «tg», «aeq. centri», «Dist. centri epic.» and «Geozentr. Dist. d. Plan.» upright; the minus sign is printed as a short dash, transcribed «−».

L03-L15. Checked: with M the centre of the deferent of radius ρ, E′ and E on the line of the apsides at the distance e on either side of M, E′ on the side of the apogee, and m = ∢ AE′Q the mean centrum measured at E′, the perpendicular from E to the line H E′ produced (L04) is E N = 2e sin m, and H N = H E′ + E′ N = (√(ρ² − e² sin² m) − e cos m) + 2e cos m = √(ρ² − e² sin² m) + e cos m, so that tg E′HE = E N : H N = 2e sin m : (√(ρ² − e² sin² m) + e cos m); this is the formula of L13 with the sine and cosine of a circle of radius R (note 1), and with R = 1 and e₁ = e : ρ, dividing above and below by ρ, that of L15.

L20-L28. Checked: S is the foot of the perpendicular from P to the line E H R; with the anomaly ψ = ∢ RHP, H S = r cos ψ and P S = r sin ψ, so that E P² = (E H + H S)² + P S², as in L27, and sin RET = P S : E P, as in L28.

L15: the subscript 1 of the last e₁ is printed broken, like a comma; a speck above the line between «sin» and «m» in the radicand. L31: the colon after «einfacher» is set close to the word (3 px), where the other colons and semicolons of the page stand after the thin space of the edition (8-14 px measured).

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.», «Nallino». Italics: «Gleichung der Anomalie und des Centrums», «Gleichung des Centrums», «mittlern» and «wahren Apogeum», «Centrum» (L09), «al-markaz», «Aequans» (L10; upright in L24), «Anomalie» (L26), «Gleichung der Anomalie», and the letters. N01: «60p», the p raised.
L10: corrected in the additions, p. 235 (JP2 0267, L15-L17): «weil er die Lage des Centrums des Epizykels in Bezug auf das Apogeum des Exzenters angibt».
